title: Primary Judge's Ruling
summary: This section discusses the primary judge's ruling regarding the evidentiary matters presented and how it impacted the interpretation of the guarantee.
content: 34 The primary judge was asked to provide a ruling pursuant to s 136 of the Evidence Act 1995 (NSW) in relation to the documentary evidence tendered by Messrs Cherry and Sharpe leading to the execution of the Guarantee and Second Variation, confining its admissibility to the estoppel defence. The submissions of counsel for the plaintiff were directed to the absence of ambiguity in the Guarantee. Thus it was put, “Precontractual conduct is only admissible on questions of construction if the contract is ambiguous. The ambiguity is just absent in this case.”
